===Overview===
* Resupply [[the Brass Coast]] army of the [[The Brass Coast military concerns#Fire of the South|Fire of the South]] with 38 wains of weirwood.
* This motion was approved by the Quartermaster General using the legal power to resupply armies granted by the [[Senate]].
* This motion would be subject to the [[Synod]] [[veto]].

===Date===
* Winter Solstice 378YE

===Progress===
* 38 wains of provided by Irontide Rad, Quartermaster General of the Imperial Armies, after Winter Solstice 378YE

===Campaign Outcome===
* [[Casualties#Emergency_Resupply|Resupply]] an army using 38 wains restores fighting strength equal to 760 soldiers to the army.
